lyrics:
[Intro: filtered disco chords, soft kick, vinyl crackle]

[Verse 1: sweet soulful male falsetto]
Face down, a towel, a paperback
I haven't read a page of that
All week I carried what I could
I set it down, and it feels good

[Chorus: filter opens, funk guitar, harmonies]
Sun on my back
Like a hand, like a hand
Sun on my back
Saying stay where you land
Nothing to carry, nothing to pack
Just the sun on my back

[Verse 2: bass busier, voice warmer]
Somebody's kid is learning to dive
Somebody's radio's playing live
I hear it all with both eyes closed
The warm goes right down to my toes

[Chorus: filter opens, funk guitar, harmonies]
Sun on my back
Like a hand, like a hand
Sun on my back
Saying stay where you land
Nothing to carry, nothing to pack
Just the sun on my back

[Instrumental: singing synth solo, slow filter sweeps]

[Outro: chords filtering down, crackle, a page turning]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 108 BPM, 4/4, F# minor with warm major sevenths. Relaxed, golden and funky.

VOICE: Male falsetto, sweet and soulful, light and unforced, with stacked harmonies in the choruses.

INSTRUMENTS: Filtered disco chords that open and close with a slow filter sweep, a funky, round bass guitar, a soft four-on-the-floor kick, a muted funk guitar, a singing analogue lead synth, Rhodes electric piano, vinyl crackle.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, filtered chords. 0:18 Verse 1. 0:54 Chorus 1, filter opens. 1:28 Verse 2. 2:04 Chorus 2. 2:38 Synth solo. 3:00 Outro, filtering down, a page at 3:16.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2010s French touch: warm, rounded and side-chained, everything slightly golden, voice silky and close.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The filter opening on 'Sun on my back' at 0:54.

STATION FIT: Sunday, 12:30 p.m. A slow, funky vocal track for lying still at the hottest part of the day.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Tired, unloading, warmed, at rest.
